michigan.impact: Potential consumer safety concerns and regulatory scrutiny for Michigan cannabis stores involved.
michigan.recommended_action: Monitor recall developments and ensure compliance with CRA directives; review product safety protocols.

federal.headline: DEA Issues First Federal Registrations to 900 Dispensaries, But Dual-Licence States Remain Uncertain - Business of Cannabis
federal.summary: DEA has granted federal registrations to over 900 medical cannabis dispensaries, though uncertainty remains for states with dual licensing.
federal.impact: Federal recognition may provide tax and operational benefits; dual-license states should monitor regulatory clarity.
federal.recommended_action: Evaluate eligibility for federal registration benefits; prepare for compliance with DEA requirements.
